retail (Kullback)

leibler/retail

Handle retail customer requests such as order queries with tools over a simulated world, rebuilt from recorded tau2-bench traces.

Open on Hugging FaceHow to run it

Good for

  • tool-using agent evaluation
  • retail policy tasks

Reward

How it is scored
Mixed
Signal
Graded, 0 to 1

A code verifier checks the end state; reward.txt is 1 only when every gated item holds, and weighted items shape a separate shaped_reward. A judge model scores some items.

How to run it

1. From the cardcopied from the publisher's own instructions

uv run harbor run -p harbor/retail-task_1c8acd15f1fb -a oracle
uv run harbor run -p harbor/retail-task_1c8acd15f1fb -a <agent> -m <provider/model>

2. Get the filesthe whole repository, to a local folder

hf download leibler/retail --repo-type dataset --local-dir retail

3. Check it with Harborcommon pattern, not from this card

# the oracle agent runs the reference solution, so no model is called
harbor run --repo https://huggingface.co/datasets/leibler/retail --agent oracle

If every task passes, the environment works on your machine. Then swap in your own agent and model. Some repositories keep the tasks in a subfolder; the card says where.

Framework documentation: Harbor. Needs: Judge model API key for judge items.

Evidence

All 223 tasks replay as recorded, but the card warns some verifiers may check the wrong thing.

As reported by the publisher. We have not reproduced it.
